description: Electronic queue management systems organise client flow without crowding or conflict. The client registers at the kiosk, receives a ticket and waits for their call. Operators serve people in strict order — everything under control.

steps.title: Registration
steps.desc: The client approaches the kiosk, selects a service and receives a ticket with a queue number and estimated waiting time.

steps.title: Waiting
steps.desc: The client waits in the seating area. Current numbers are shown on the display board in real time.

steps.title: Call
steps.desc: The operator presses the call button. The client's number and counter appear on the main board and the counter display.

steps.title: Service
steps.desc: The client approaches the counter. The system automatically records service time and statistics.

results: Reduced perceived waiting time and client frustration
